text:
Jordan P: Quick sync — proposing a partner-facing contract bump (v3) to tidy response envelope and tighten a few enums. Goal: avoid silent breakages across CloudMarket + SI installs.
Lisa M: Is this a hard break? partners will need clear migration expectations.
Jordan P: Small break. Plan: opt-in canary -> SDK adapter shim -> 2-stage roll. Target window: 9 weeks.
Samir K: Runtime-wise we should honor an explicit header so routing/fallbacks are trivial. Example header: X-Contract-Version: 3
Ming Zhao: Add a compat metric: contract_compat = OK|WARN|FAIL. Also emit a one-time telemetry event contract.check.
Priya S: Partners (esp. EdgeWorks SI) asking for 6 weeks notice + draft messaging review. Marketplace partners want a beta channel.
Jordan P: Proposed cadence: week0 partner heads-up under embargo, week2 public migration doc + SDK minor with opt-in shim, week5 marketplace beta channel, week7 partner test window, week9 flip default.
Lisa M: Need Dedicated/private grace: add `compatibility_mode=legacy` flag that auto-unsets 2w after flip.
Samir K: SDK tasks: support Accept-Contract header, show deprecation warning on first call, provide adapter shim with enable_envelope_shim=true.
Ming Zhao: Ops notes: deploy beta to marketplace-canary-7, watch contract_compat events, create alert for FAIL spikes.
Priya S: I'll arrange partner review sessions and a one-pager for joint announcements. Legal sign-off required on consumer wording.
Legal: Recommend avoid the word "breaking" externally; suggest "contract update" and provide a clear rollback statement.
release-bot: beta deployed to marketplace-canary-7 at commit g7f2a1  watching contract_compat.
Jordan P: Action items:
- Jordan: draft partner-facing wording and loop Legal (due in 2 business days)
- Samir: SDK adapter PR + telemetry (due EOW)
- Ming: runtime header + metric + legacy flag (due next Wed)
- Priya: partner invites + one-pager + draft messaging (due in 3 days)
- Lisa: Dedicated/private grace SLA blurb (due in 1 week)
Priya S: noted, will share calendar invites once Legal gives greenlight. :thumbsup:
Lisa M: +1
Samir K: ack
Ming Zhao: ack
Jordan P: will post updated runbook and migration checklist here after Legal signoff.
